lines.text: In the second year of Darius, Zechariah saw a man riding a red horse among the myrtle trees.
The riders told the angel of the LORD they had patrolled the earth, and it was at rest.
The angel of the LORD asked how long God would withhold mercy from Jerusalem, angry for seventy years.
The LORD said He would return to Jerusalem with mercy, and His gates would be rebuilt there.
Zechariah saw four horns that scattered Judah, and then four craftsmen who came to terrify them.
